t: What Does The Name Ashgan Mean?
s: In Arabic-script contexts, the spelling عشگان reinforces the “love” etymology via the ‘ishq root, whereas in Persian-script contexts you will also see اشگان or عشقان, with regional preferences shaping both meaning emphasis and pronunciation. Overall, Ashgan (and its variants Ashghan/Eshgan) stands at the intersection of Persian ‘love’-based naming and broader Middle Eastern onomastic exchange, with modern nicknaming patterns and transliteration choices reflecting that blend.
